title: •Reegesk
caption: •Reegesk (V)
lore: Ranat thief and scavenger from Aralia. Regularly trades with Jawas. Adept at pilfering items without alerting the owner. Willing to steal anything, even trash.
game_text: During opponent’s turn, if present at a battleground site, may steal a device, droid, starfighter, vehicle, or weapon in opponent’s Lost Pile into your hand.
